news.title: Champions of the World: England’s Para Lions Deliver IFCPF Men’s World Cup Triumph to Cherish
news.lede: England are world champions, and they earned their moment through nerve, quality and an unshakeable refusal to accept defeat. Against tournament hosts the United States, the Para Lions overturned a late deficit to win 2–1 after extra time, bringing a glorious conclusion to their campaign in Georgia. For head coach Jack Rutter and his players, this was the reward for years of ambition, preparation and persistence. England’s first World Cup title in cerebral palsy football belongs to a squad whose performances deserve a prominent place in the nation’s sporting celebrations.

news.title: FIFA's Infantino claims 'vast majority' support before election
news.lede: FIFA's embattled president Gianni Infantino said he has the backing of the "vast, vast majority" of football despite his failed plan to sell stakes in the World Cup. Infantino is seeking re-election next year in the face of attempts to force him to stand down following the divisive plan. He infuriated football leaders in Europe, North America and Asia over the proposal to sell profits in the World Cup through a commercial subsidiary. But in an interview released on Saturday with the BBC at the Under-15 World Cup in Azerbaijan, Infantino brushed off calls for him to step down.
